reply_text:
*One ship-blocking finding* in `billing-anniversary` against `main`.

*CRITICAL — Renewal dates use the wrong month’s length* — `src/schedule.js:6–7`
The day is clamped against the *source* month, then used to construct a date in the *next* month. This can skip a renewal month or renew early:
• Jan 31, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 3*, expected Feb 28.
• Jan 31, 2028, anchor 31 → *Mar 2*, expected Feb 29.
• Feb 28, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, expected Mar 31.

*Recommended fix:* Clamp the original anchor against the *target* month’s length. Add regression tests for shorter months, leap February, and returning from February to March without anchor drift.

*INFORMATIONAL:* None.

All 5 existing tests pass, but the month/anchor boundary check found 40 incorrect results across 1,116 cases. No files changed.
